Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning the appointment of nonvoting advisory members to commodity boards.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the appointment of nonvoting advisory members tocommodity boards; and adding a new section to chapter 15.65 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 15.65 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) A commodity board may appoint up to two nonvoting advisorymembers to the board who have expertise in marketing, operations, orother topics relevant to the work of the board. The term of office foreach nonvoting advisory member must be established in each board'smarketing order or agreement, but may not exceed three years.Nonvoting advisory members may serve additional consecutive terms ofoffice if reappointed by the board. (2) Nonvoting advisory members do not count toward establishing aquorum of the board. (3) Nonvoting advisory members must be compensated in the samemanner as board members under RCW 15.65.270(4).
